label: Input steps 3-5 of sequences starting with l, right after an i/a/j/o
explanation: Sparse feature that fires during the original-input phase, almost entirely at steps 3-5 (t=4 alone carries about 61% of the mass). It never fires in the copy phase and only weakly at <DEL>. It depends strongly on the first token: 81% of activation mass is in sequences starting with l (22x lift), and some is in sequences starting with 2. It is boosted when the previous input is i (14x lift, 48% of mass), j or a, and when the current input is k (7x). The strongest examples look like l 2 a i [k] or l l p a [k]. The simple condition first_tok=l and t in 3..5 covers 76% of the mass but has only 6% precision. Adding prev_tok in {i,a,j,o} raises precision to about 29% (dev F1 0.36). Magnitude is highest for k following i/a in l-initial sequences. It does not fire at t<3, at t>=7, or in the copy phase. The conjunction is clearly incomplete, and the remaining activations are spread over many other contexts.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=l (+8.84), prev_tok=i (+6.79), orig0=2 (+4.85), prev2_tok=i (+4.41), t=4 (+4.07), prev_tok=j (+4.04). Lower it: correct=1 (-7.77), phase=2 (-3.42), prev2_tok=x (-2.89), t=7 (-2.75).
